objective: Milestone 4: Source Pipeline Freshness and Access Control

tasks.description: Implement shared source-refresh tracking service and UI indicator to record and display when all active enabled sources have completed their collection cycles, surfacing refresh status, completion timestamps, and outstanding overdue counts in the admin operations summary.
acceptance_criteria: trackSourceRefreshCycle(sql) calculates or records completion metrics across all enabled non-synthetic sources
Exposes lastCompleteRefreshAt, totalSources, completedSources, and overdueCount
Admin operations summary at /admin/operations displays the shared refresh status card with bilingual labels
Zero private user data or raw request credentials exposed
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/refresh-tracker.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement automated robots.txt access policy parser and validator to evaluate candidate official source URLs against host access rules before collection scheduling.
acceptance_criteria: parseRobotsTxt(content) parses User-agent, Allow, Disallow, and Crawl-delay directives
isUrlAllowed(robotsRules, url, userAgent) correctly determines path allowance with standard wildcard and prefix matching rules
Extracts host crawl-delay in seconds and enforces maximum bounded limits
Handles malformed content, empty files, comments, and missing directives gracefully with safe defaults (allow if not explicitly disallowed)
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/robots-policy.test.ts && npm run typecheck

tasks.description: Implement pre-reminder official source freshness verification workflow to validate that opportunities are not withdrawn or 404 before dispatching urgent deadline reminders.
acceptance_criteria: verifyReminderCandidateFreshness(sql, candidate) verifies source freshness within 24h of reminder due time
Detects withdrawn/missing opportunities (HTTP 404/410 or explicit withdrawal state) and suppresses scheduled reminder dispatch
Preserves idempotency and prevents duplicate reminder attempts for verified or suppressed candidates
Retains local-sink isolation; no live external requests without injected/mocked transport in tests
validation: node --import tsx --test tests/reminder-recheck.test.ts && npm run typecheck
